title: Certifying Regime Detectors Before Use — frozen pre-registration lineage
description: Archival deposit of the frozen pre-registration protocol cited by the manuscript 'Certifying Regime Detectors Before Use' (DOI 10.2139/ssrn.7100358). Contains the numbers-free v3.0 pre-check pre-registration (git commit 720c1d4), the D-07 pre-result amendment (dd44e7a), the v4.0 freeze anchor (1dc5c82), and machine-readable commit and run timestamps. Git commit ordering in the development repository is the ordering evidence; because git committer timestamps are self-reported, this deposit provides independent fixity of document content only. The deposit date post-dates the cited runs and therefore does not constitute a prospective pre-registration timestamp.
